d: Chestnut brown hair is styled in a ponytail with long bangs and side locks framing a youthful face with large, gentle dark brown eyes. A slender build is dressed in a white collared shirt with a grey ribbon tie, a short pleated charcoal grey skirt, charcoal grey knee-high socks, and white sneakers with red soles. A tan tactical chest rig is worn over the torso, accompanied by a white shoulder bag adorned with small charms and a tan-colored futuristic firearm held in the right hand.
